data.command: Tell me about your network configuration

data.text:
Our server is running Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS with kernel 5.15.0-91. We're using the netfilter firewall with the default configuration, which is a combination of UFW (Ubuntu Firewall) and netfilter rules. The firewall is configured to allow incoming traffic on port 80 for HTTP, port 443 for HTTPS, and port 22 for SSH. We also have a rule to allow incoming traffic on port 8080 for our web application server, which is running on port 8080 of the IP address 192.168.1.100.

Here's a snippet from the UFW configuration file (`/etc/ufw/before.rules`):
```bash
# Generated by ufw
# Last changed by ufw on 2023-02-20 14:30

# Allow all on eth0
# ALLOW OUT on eth0
# ALLOW IN on eth0

# Allow HTTP
# ALLOW IN on eth0 from any to any port 80

# Allow HTTPS
# ALLOW IN on eth0 from any to any port 443

# Allow SSH
# ALLOW IN on eth0 from any to any port 22

# Allow web application server
# ALLOW IN on eth0
